title: quant-research-framework: a walk-forward backtester with ledger invariant tests and tolerance-bounded cross-language parity
description: The Python reference half of a dual-engine walk-forward backtester. Strict no-look-ahead enforced by ledger-level invariant and property tests, walk-forward optimisation, regime segmentation, a four-axis robustness suite, Monte Carlo diagnostics and overfitting statistics. A Rust port reproduces its metric output within 1e-3 relative tolerance, checked in CI.
